raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

The non-all-to-all PCP path gathers hidden states and router logits across PCP ranks, but the router still reads the rank-local padding mask. With N local rows and P PCP ranks, routing processes P*N rows while the mask still has N entries. CUDA top-k checks that the mask length matches the token count and can raise an `is_padding` size mismatch.

This PR aligns the MoE padding mask with the PCP-gathered token rows and restores the original rank-local mask in a `finally` block. The dispatch/combine interfaces and PCP1/all-to-all paths remain unchanged. Regression tests cover PCP1/2/4, the all-to-all bypass, per-forward caching, and exception cleanup.

A search of open PRs covering PCP padding, PCP MoE, and the relevant padding-cache key found no equivalent fix. Nearby PRs #53639, #60049, and #56258 address different paths.

## Implementation

- Non-all-to-all PCP routing receives a padding mask with the same rank-major layout and row count as the gathered hidden states.
- The original local padding mask is restored on normal and exceptional exits.
- The gathered mask is cached per forward context and reused across MoE calls.

## Validation

### Environment

- Model: official `mistralai/Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603` native FP8 checkpoint.
- Image: `vllm/vllm-openai:nightly-81198e97ba7eee2a22540caaa756b7fdddcb4d93`.
- Hardware: two nodes, each with 4x NVIDIA H20 GPUs.

### vLLM startup arguments

```bash
# Set MASTER_ADDR to the reachable IP address of the master node.
vllm serve /models/Mistral-Small-4-119B-2603 \
  --host 0.0.0.0 \
  --port 19180 \
  --served-model-name mistral-small4-pcp-ab \
  --config-format mistral \
  --load-format mistral \
  --tokenizer-mode mistral \
  --dtype bfloat16 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 2 \
  --prefill-context-parallel-size 2 \
  --pipeline-parallel-size 1 \
  --data-parallel-size 1 \
  --decode-context-parallel-size 1 \
  --distributed-executor-backend mp \
  --master-addr "${MASTER_ADDR}" \
  --master-port 29511 \
  --language-model-only \
  --enforce-eager \
  --attention-backend TRITON_MLA \
  --moe-backend triton \
  --max-model-len 4096 \
  --max-num-batched-tokens 2048 \
  --max-num-seqs 4 \
  --block-size 64 \
  --kv-cache-dtype auto \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.80 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching \
  --no-async-scheduling
```

### Result

**Without this fix** (baseline): 
With the unmodified image and model, all seven native weight shards loaded (29.34 GiB per rank). The unpatched run then failed during vLLM's standard startup memory profiling, before the API server became ready:

```text
RuntimeError: .../topk_softmax_kernels.cu:785, is_padding size mismatch, expected: 4096
```

**With this PR**:
Applying the `_sequence_parallel_context` change from this PR at startup allowed the TP2/PCP2 deployment to start and generate successfully. It passed all five chat smoke requests, including a 2,235-token input and concurrent requests of different lengths.

Using the official `tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py` scoring logic, we evaluated all 1,319 test examples with 5-shot prompts, temperature=0, seed=42, `max_tokens=256`, and concurrency=4. Results:

| Run  | GSM8K | Invalid answers | Runtime result |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Baseline + TP4/PCP1 | 1191/1319 (90.2957%) | 0 | Full evaluation completed; 0 API errors and 0 Pod restarts |
| Baseline + TP2/PCP2 | Could not run | — | Failed during startup profiling with the padding-size mismatch above |
| This PR applied + TP2/PCP2 | 1197/1319 (90.7506%) | 0 | Full evaluation completed; 0 API errors and 0 Pod restarts |

AI assistance was used to extract the change, prepare regression tests and run the validation described above. The human submitter retains responsibility for line-by-line review and final sign-off.

[Full report here](https://production.mcp.bytebell.ai/vllm-project/vllm/main/60946)
## Findings — 9 in 2 files

### [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py)

#### major · bug · [lines 661–665](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L661-L665)

Guard omits do_naive_dispatch_combine, so when naive EP dispatch rewrites the token axis before the PCP gather, the mask is only P×local and can still mismatch.

Evidence:

- change [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 661-665](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L661-L665) — The new mask-gather condition tests only pcp_size>1 and not use_all2all_kernels; do_naive_dispatch_combine is never consulted.
- base [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 811-825](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L811-L825) — _maybe_dispatch first runs get_ep_group().dispatch_router_logits and only then all_gathers hidden_states/router_logits over the PCP group, so routing rows are P×(EP-dispatched rows).
- base [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 796-800](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L796-L800) — do_naive_dispatch_combine is a separate gate (dp_size>1 or is_sequence_parallel, and not supports_internal_mk) that can be true at the same time as the PCP condition.

#### minor · bug · [lines 667–673](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L667-L673)

Cached gather is never invalidated: additional_kwargs lives for the whole context, so a later MoE call whose local mask changed reuses stale rows.

Evidence:

- change [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 667-673](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L667-L673) — The gathered mask is stored under "pcp_moe_is_padding" and only ever read back; the finally at 686-687 restores ctx.is_padding but leaves the cached tensor in place.
- base [`vllm/forward_context.py` 197-197](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/forward_context.py#L197) — additional_kwargs is a plain per-ForwardContext dict with default_factory=dict; nothing prunes keys from it.
- base [`vllm/forward_context.py` 238-258](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/forward_context.py#L238-L258) — create_forward_context is the only writer of the field and just forwards the caller's dict, so a reused context keeps the previous pass's cached gather.
- base [`vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/model.py` 951-955](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/model.py#L951-L955) — Model code rewrites forward_context.is_padding per call via sp_padding_mask, so the field the cache keyed on is mutable while the cache is not.

#### minor · performance · [lines 668–672](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L668-L672)

Gather runs whenever a mask is set, yet every mask consumer gates on VLLM_MOE_SKIP_PADDING, so with that flag off it adds a per-pass PCP collective nobody reads.

Evidence:

- change [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 661-672](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L661-L672) — Condition is is_padding is not None and PCP non-all2all; envs.VLLM_MOE_SKIP_PADDING is not part of the guard.
- base [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/router/fused_topk_router.py` 19-23](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/router/fused_topk_router.py#L19-L23) — The only reader of ctx.is_padding in the router returns None unless envs.VLLM_MOE_SKIP_PADDING is set.
- base [`vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/model.py` 459-463](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/model.py#L459-L463) — The model-side consumer is guarded the same way, so with the flag off the gathered tensor has no reader.

### [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py)

#### minor · tests · [line 80](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L80)

Every case supplies a tensor mask, so the new `local_is_padding is not None` guard is never exercised; deleting it leaves this test green.

Evidence:

- change [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py` 53-56,80](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L53-L56) — parametrization varies only pcp_size/use_all2all and the mask is always torch.tensor([False, True])
- change [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 661-664](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L661-L664) — the guard's false branch skips the gather and the restores; no case in this test reaches it
- change [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py` 98-104](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L98-L104) — the assertions pin the gathered mask and the one-gather count only for a mask that is present

#### minor · tests · [line 82](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L82)

dp_metadata is left None, so the sp_local_sizes branch of the wrapped context — entered in real PCP forwards — is never combined with the gathered mask.

Evidence:

- change [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py` 82-99](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L82-L99) — ForwardContext({}, {}, {}, is_padding=padding) sets no dp_metadata, so only the nullcontext branch is entered
- base [`vllm/forward_context.py` 299-328](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/forward_context.py#L299-L328) — set_forward_context builds dp_metadata whenever dp_size>1 or use_sequence_parallel_moe, the configurations this fix targets
- base [`vllm/forward_context.py` 109-122](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/forward_context.py#L109-L122) — sp_local_sizes is the CM the new with-block wraps; it rewrites local_sizes, the SP token chunking

#### minor · tests · [line 83](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L83)

The test re-declares the gather predicate and hard-codes do_naive_dispatch_combine=False, so it cannot catch drift between the mask-gather condition and the real dispatch condition.

Evidence:

- change [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py` 62-67,83-86](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L62-L67) — runner is a SimpleNamespace with do_naive_dispatch_combine=False written in, and `dispatched` restates the predicate instead of reading the runner
- base [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 796-800](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L796-L800) — do_naive_dispatch_combine is a computed property (dp_size>1 or is_sequence_parallel) and not supports_internal_mk, not the constant the test substitutes
- base [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 811-825](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L811-L825) — the dispatch predicate under test lives here; the test's copy of it is what the assertions are compared against

#### minor · tests · [lines 94–104](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L94-L104)

New test only asserts ctx.is_padding and the gather count; nothing exercises the router/top-k path the fix targets, so the reported mismatch stays untested.

Evidence:

- change [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py` 88-104](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L88-L104) — Two loop iterations enter the context and assert only mask contents numel, restore identity and padding_gathers; no select_experts/topk call.
- change [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 666-673](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L666-L673) — The behaviour under test is the cached gather installed as ctx.is_padding, consumed in production by the routers.

#### minor · tests · [line 98](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L98)

Mask order is pinned only against the mock's own concatenation; a real gather that is not rank-major in the hidden-state order still passes.

Evidence:

- change [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py` 70-75,84-86](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L70-L75) — the fake inverts each simulated peer's mask and the expected list is built from that same inversion
- base [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 820-825](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L820-L825) — the hidden-state gather this mask must line up with is dim=0 rank-major; the test never derives the expectation from it

#### minor · tests · [line 100](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L100)

This assertion cannot fail: the mock gathers hidden+4 with the same rank offsets as hidden, so logits always equals states+4 by construction.

Evidence:

- change [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py` 70-75](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L70-L75) — the fake all_gather adds rank*100 to every tensor it is handed, identically for both tensors
- change [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py` 95-100](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L95-L100) — logits is gather(hidden+4) and states is gather(hidden), so logits == states+4 is an identity, not a check

files.patch:
@@ -1,13 +1,16 @@
 # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 # SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
 from collections.abc import Callable
+from contextlib import nullcontext
+from types import SimpleNamespace
 from unittest.mock import patch
 
 import pytest
 import torch
 
 from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
 from vllm.distributed.eplb.eplb_state import EplbLayerState
+from vllm.forward_context import ForwardContext, override_forward_context
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.config import RoutingMethodType
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.router.base_router import (
     eplb_map_to_physical_and_record,
@@ -24,6 +27,7 @@
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.router.router_factory import (
     create_fused_moe_router,
 )
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.runner import moe_runner
 from vllm.model_executor.models.llama4 import Llama4MoE
 from vllm.platforms import current_platform
 
@@ -46,6 +50,60 @@ def _is_aiter_capable() -> bool:
 NUM_EXPERTS = [8, 16, 64]
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "pcp_size,use_all2all", [(1, False), (2, False), (4, False), (2, True)]
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("raise_error", [False, True])
+def test_pcp_routing_padding_is_gathered_and_restored(
+    pcp_size, use_all2all, raise_error, monkeypatch
+):
+    """Routing uses the gathered mask and restores local padding on every exit."""
+    runner = SimpleNamespace(
+        do_naive_dispatch_combine=False,
+        moe_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            pcp_size=pcp_size,
+            moe_parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(use_all2all_kernels=use_all2all),
+        ),
+    )
+    padding_gathers = 0
+
+    def all_gather(tensor, dim):
+        nonlocal padding_gathers
+        if tensor.dtype == torch.uint8:
+            padding_gathers += 1
+            return torch.cat([tensor] + [1 - tensor] * (pcp_size - 1), dim=dim)
+        return torch.cat([tensor + rank * 100 for rank in range(pcp_size)], dim=dim)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        moe_runner, "get_pcp_group", lambda: SimpleNamespace(all_gather=all_gather)
+    )
+    padding = torch.tensor([False, True])
+    hidden = torch.tensor([[3.0], [7.0]])
+    context = ForwardContext({}, {}, {}, is_padding=padding)
+    dispatched = pcp_size > 1 and not use_all2all
+    expected = (
+        [False, True] + [True, False] * (pcp_size - 1) if dispatched else [False, True]
+    )
+    with override_forward_context(context):

This is a Bytebell Pull request verifier bot.
Here is our verification report for this PR

[Full report here](https://production.mcp.bytebell.ai/vllm-project/vllm/main/60946)
## Findings — 9 in 2 files

### [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py)

#### major · bug · [lines 661–665](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L661-L665)

Guard omits do_naive_dispatch_combine, so when naive EP dispatch rewrites the token axis before the PCP gather, the mask is only P×local and can still mismatch.

Evidence:

- change [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 661-665](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L661-L665) — The new mask-gather condition tests only pcp_size>1 and not use_all2all_kernels; do_naive_dispatch_combine is never consulted.
- base [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 811-825](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L811-L825) — _maybe_dispatch first runs get_ep_group().dispatch_router_logits and only then all_gathers hidden_states/router_logits over the PCP group, so routing rows are P×(EP-dispatched rows).
- base [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 796-800](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L796-L800) — do_naive_dispatch_combine is a separate gate (dp_size>1 or is_sequence_parallel, and not supports_internal_mk) that can be true at the same time as the PCP condition.

#### minor · bug · [lines 667–673](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L667-L673)

Cached gather is never invalidated: additional_kwargs lives for the whole context, so a later MoE call whose local mask changed reuses stale rows.

Evidence:

- change [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 667-673](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L667-L673) — The gathered mask is stored under "pcp_moe_is_padding" and only ever read back; the finally at 686-687 restores ctx.is_padding but leaves the cached tensor in place.
- base [`vllm/forward_context.py` 197-197](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/forward_context.py#L197) — additional_kwargs is a plain per-ForwardContext dict with default_factory=dict; nothing prunes keys from it.
- base [`vllm/forward_context.py` 238-258](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/forward_context.py#L238-L258) — create_forward_context is the only writer of the field and just forwards the caller's dict, so a reused context keeps the previous pass's cached gather.
- base [`vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/model.py` 951-955](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/model.py#L951-L955) — Model code rewrites forward_context.is_padding per call via sp_padding_mask, so the field the cache keyed on is mutable while the cache is not.

#### minor · performance · [lines 668–672](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L668-L672)

Gather runs whenever a mask is set, yet every mask consumer gates on VLLM_MOE_SKIP_PADDING, so with that flag off it adds a per-pass PCP collective nobody reads.

Evidence:

- change [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 661-672](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L661-L672) — Condition is is_padding is not None and PCP non-all2all; envs.VLLM_MOE_SKIP_PADDING is not part of the guard.
- base [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/router/fused_topk_router.py` 19-23](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/router/fused_topk_router.py#L19-L23) — The only reader of ctx.is_padding in the router returns None unless envs.VLLM_MOE_SKIP_PADDING is set.
- base [`vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/model.py` 459-463](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/model.py#L459-L463) — The model-side consumer is guarded the same way, so with the flag off the gathered tensor has no reader.

### [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py)

#### minor · tests · [line 80](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L80)

Every case supplies a tensor mask, so the new `local_is_padding is not None` guard is never exercised; deleting it leaves this test green.

Evidence:

- change [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py` 53-56,80](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L53-L56) — parametrization varies only pcp_size/use_all2all and the mask is always torch.tensor([False, True])
- change [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 661-664](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L661-L664) — the guard's false branch skips the gather and the restores; no case in this test reaches it
- change [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py` 98-104](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L98-L104) — the assertions pin the gathered mask and the one-gather count only for a mask that is present

#### minor · tests · [line 82](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L82)

dp_metadata is left None, so the sp_local_sizes branch of the wrapped context — entered in real PCP forwards — is never combined with the gathered mask.

Evidence:

- change [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py` 82-99](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L82-L99) — ForwardContext({}, {}, {}, is_padding=padding) sets no dp_metadata, so only the nullcontext branch is entered
- base [`vllm/forward_context.py` 299-328](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/forward_context.py#L299-L328) — set_forward_context builds dp_metadata whenever dp_size>1 or use_sequence_parallel_moe, the configurations this fix targets
- base [`vllm/forward_context.py` 109-122](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/forward_context.py#L109-L122) — sp_local_sizes is the CM the new with-block wraps; it rewrites local_sizes, the SP token chunking

#### minor · tests · [line 83](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L83)

The test re-declares the gather predicate and hard-codes do_naive_dispatch_combine=False, so it cannot catch drift between the mask-gather condition and the real dispatch condition.

Evidence:

- change [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py` 62-67,83-86](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L62-L67) — runner is a SimpleNamespace with do_naive_dispatch_combine=False written in, and `dispatched` restates the predicate instead of reading the runner
- base [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 796-800](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L796-L800) — do_naive_dispatch_combine is a computed property (dp_size>1 or is_sequence_parallel) and not supports_internal_mk, not the constant the test substitutes
- base [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 811-825](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L811-L825) — the dispatch predicate under test lives here; the test's copy of it is what the assertions are compared against

#### minor · tests · [lines 94–104](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L94-L104)

New test only asserts ctx.is_padding and the gather count; nothing exercises the router/top-k path the fix targets, so the reported mismatch stays untested.

Evidence:

- change [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py` 88-104](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L88-L104) — Two loop iterations enter the context and assert only mask contents numel, restore identity and padding_gathers; no select_experts/topk call.
- change [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 666-673](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L666-L673) — The behaviour under test is the cached gather installed as ctx.is_padding, consumed in production by the routers.

#### minor · tests · [line 98](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L98)

Mask order is pinned only against the mock's own concatenation; a real gather that is not rank-major in the hidden-state order still passes.

Evidence:

- change [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py` 70-75,84-86](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L70-L75) — the fake inverts each simulated peer's mask and the expected list is built from that same inversion
- base [`vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py` 820-825](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/8674a794c788d4c7dac10c6f7ddfdae677588d18/vllm/model_executor/layers/fused_moe/runner/moe_runner.py#L820-L825) — the hidden-state gather this mask must line up with is dim=0 rank-major; the test never derives the expectation from it

#### minor · tests · [line 100](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L100)

Evidence:

- change [`tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py` 70-75](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/blob/d0f4392dadb7901f7f41068936796eade93225f4/tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py#L70-L75) — the fake all_gather adds rank*100 to every tensor it is handed, identically for both tensors
